meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow: the user themselves saying ulw-plan, ulw plan, /skill:ulw-plan, or asking in their own words for a work plan before coding. NEVER self-activates: a bare ulw/ultrawork run, an agent-side routing decision, or reading this file is not a request, and the plan-gated reviewers (metis/momus) stay locked without a user request plus a written .omo/plans plan file. Explore-first planning consultant (Prometheus) that grounds in the codebase, asks only the forks exploration cannot resolve - or researches them to best practice when the intent is fuzzy - waits for explicit approval, then writes ONE decision-complete work plan a worker executes with zero further interview. Triggers: ulw-plan, ulw plan, plan this, make a plan, plan before coding, interview me, break this down, start planning, plan mode.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把模糊想法问成一份可照做的开发计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望在动手写代码前先得到一个清晰、完整、可执行的实施步骤。
copy.tagline_en: Turn vague ideas into an actionable development plan before coding.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a clear, executable plan before writing any code.

howto.what: 激活后Claude进入计划模式：先承诺不直接实施，并行只读探索代码库并做研究；判断意图(清晰/不清晰)后，只问必要的取舍问题；经你批准后写出一份决策完整、无需再追问即可执行的工作计划。不会修改产品代码。
howto.when: 仅当用户明确要求此规划流程时触发，例如说出“ulw-plan”“ulw plan”等，或主动要求“先做计划再编码”。不会自行启动；单独运行ulw或代理自行路由不算触发。

say.text: 帮我用ulw-plan规划登录接口的限流改造
say.note: 触发Prometheus流程：先探查再出计划，不写码

say.text: 进入计划模式：给我一份后端重构的完整计划
say.note: 会先宣布意图判断，批准后才生成计划文件

say.text: 我还没想清需求，把“改进认证”拆成计划
say.note: 意图模糊时它会自行调研并采用最佳实践默认值，不会反复追问

howto.what_en: Claude plans first: read-only exploration, no code edits, announces intent, asks only necessary questions, waits for approval, then writes one decision-complete work plan a worker executes with zero further interviews.
howto.when_en: Only on an explicit user request for the planning workflow, e.g. saying “ulw-plan” or asking for a plan before coding. It never self-activates; a bare ulw run or agent-side routing does not trigger it.

say_en.text: Help me use ulw-plan to plan the login rate limit.
say_en.note: Prometheus plans first; it won't code directly.

say_en.text: Enter plan mode and give me a full backend refactor plan.
say_en.note: Shows intent verdict; plan written only after approval.

say_en.text: I don't know what I need yet—break 'improve auth' into a plan.
say_en.note: Fuzzy intent: explores, uses defaults, doesn't over-ask.
